# sigma_data_models (Data Source)

Lists Sigma data models. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_data_models" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exclude_tags` (Boolean) Whether to exclude tags (`excludeTags`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `skip_permission_check` (Boolean) Whether to skip permission checks (`skipPermissionCheck`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.

### Read-Only

- `data_models` (Attributes List) Data models in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_models))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data_models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_models`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `id` (String) Data model ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the data model is archived.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest data model version.
- `name` (String) Data model name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner member ID.
- `path` (String) Data model path.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Version tags on the data model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_models--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Data model URL.
- `url_id` (String) Data model URL ID.

<a id="nestedatt--data_models--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_models.tags`

Read-Only:

- `source_version` (Number) Source version.
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name.
- `tagged_at` (String) When the data model was tagged.
- `version_tag_id` (String) Version tag ID.
